# Faith Behavioral Health

> Faith Behavioral Health provides comprehensive psychiatric and behavioral health services including specialized treatment for neurodevelopmental disorders, anxiety conditions, and innovative therapies like TMS.

Led by Dr. Sadaf Noor, MD, Faith Behavioral Health offers both in-person and telehealth psychiatry services across multiple treatment modalities. The practice specializes in evidence-based treatments including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), and medication management for children, adolescents, and adults.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS)
- ADHD Treatment
- Autism Spectrum Disorder
- Telehealth Psychiatry
- Dr. Sadaf Noor, MD
- Mental Health Services
- Behavioral Therapy
- Social Anxiety Treatment
- Conduct Disorder
- Tourette Syndrome
- Virtual Appointments
- Medication Management
- Habit Reversal Training

## Psychiatric Treatment Services

- [ADHD Psychiatrist - ADHD Treatment for Adult & Children](https://faithbehavioralhealth.com/adhd-psychiatrist): ADHD treatment services for adults, children, and teenagers at Faith Behavioral Health
- [Autism Spectrum Disorder Treatment - TMS Therapy](https://faithbehavioralhealth.com/autism-spectrum-disorder-treatment): ASD treatment using TMS therapy and behavioral health services from Dr. Sadaf Noor
- [Social Anxiety Treatment - Therapy and CBT for Social Phobia](https://faithbehavioralhealth.com/social-anxiety-treatment): Social anxiety and phobia treatment with CBT and exposure therapy from Dr. Sadaf Noor
- [Conduct Disorder Treatment-Treating Adults, Teens & Children](https://faithbehavioralhealth.com/conduct-disorder-treatment): Conduct disorder treatment for children, teenagers, and adults with personalized care plans
- [Tourette Syndrome Treatment in Adults, Children and Kids](https://faithbehavioralhealth.com/tourette-syndrome-treatment): Tourette Syndrome evaluation and treatment with CBT and medication management services

## Specialized Behavioral Therapies

- [Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation Therapy - TMS Treatment](https://faithbehavioralhealth.com/tms-therapy): TMS therapy for depression, anxiety, and PTSD with Dr. Sadaf Noor
- [Skin Picking Disorder Treatment - Excoriation Treatment](https://faithbehavioralhealth.com/skin-picking-disorder-treatment): Excoriation disorder treatment with CBT, medication, and habit reversal training
- [Trichotillomania Treatment - Hair Pulling Disorder Treatment](https://faithbehavioralhealth.com/trichotillomania-treatment): Hair pulling disorder treatment with CBT and behavioral therapy for all ages

## Telehealth & Access

- [Telepsychiatry Services - Telehealth Therapy & Treatments](https://faithbehavioralhealth.com/telepsychiatry-services): Telehealth psychiatry services and virtual appointments with Dr. Sadaf Noor
- [Request An Appointment - Faith Behavioral Health](https://faithbehavioralhealth.com/request-an-appointment): Book appointments with Faith Behavioral Health providers including Dr. Sadaf Noor
